title: 4 million lines changed in my game project so far...over 7000 agent tasks...over 800 updates/version changes...
author: romansamurai
selftext:
I've been working 4-6 hours a day after work and usually after my kids are asleep, for the last 3 months:  
And...systems, mechanics, **polishing, tuning and balancing** are the hardest parts...but damn what a time.  Just to be able to do this...over 7000 agent tasks, 800 version updates and changes to the game itself, multiple changes per version so way more than 800, I can't imagine the amount of human labor, time and money this would require for someone to do before...and still not done.  Hopefully it will be something players will enjoy playing.
